contexts.text: The sons of Shem, Elam and Ashur, and Arphaxad...(These) were so many nations, by which are signified those things which are of wisdom; by Elam, faith from charity; by Ashur, reason thence; by Arphaxad, science thence. AC 1227. AC 1230. AC 1235. AC 1329. AC 1334. AC 1336. AC 1339. AC 1341.
With these nations there was an inward Church.
